case.summary: This investigation was triggered by an autonomous monitor detecting purchases across three different customers using a single rare device profile, including transaction 3460296 for $125.05 on card C09900-K1. The transaction model scored the event at 0.824, and step-up authentication confirmed the cardholder did not authorize the purchase. The verdict is card-not-present fraud. The final actions are to block the card and create a case.
